name: Magic: The Gathering
tagline: Singles and decks — see the cards, then deal.

clone.rule: MTG is the reference fixture, not an item schema to copy. Use the domain-neutral CUBE v2 compiler. Generated candidates never contain copied stock, buyers or payment identities.
steps: Provide independent silo configuration with brand, locale, ISO currency, fulfilment, legal pack and domain_fields
Inspect empty public catalogue and separate pending seed-review queue
Run CUBE generic integrity, isolation, supply and checkout lifecycle tests
Apply independently reviewed jurisdiction legal pack and obtain public release approval
Activate provider checkout only after trusted supply attestation, settlement and fulfilment gates

accept_when: catalog empty or every product has verified supply fields
list path works without cross-silo data
no revenue claim without settled payment evidence
public copy has no internal control-plane language

community_blocks.title: List a single
community_blocks.body: Name, condition, NZD price, city. Buyers see a clean card face — not a blurry album.

community_blocks.title: Buy with eyes open
community_blocks.body: Open lists for decks. Clear terms for singles. Confirm before you pay or ship.

community_blocks.title: Trade carefully
community_blocks.body: Accounts keep people reachable. Deals stay between humans who show up as themselves.
